text: This might be me overreacting, I'm minding my niece Ellie (10) tonight while her mum's away. She's 39.8 on the thermometer, says her throat is sore but she's still drinking ok, and she's all bunged up and sneezing nonstop. I checked her all over for any rash and there's nothing, and the few freckly marks she has just fade when I press a glass on them. Only reason I panicked for a sec was her lips and round her mouth looked purplish, but it wipes off with a flannel. She's been knocking back blackcurrant squash all evening. Is 39.8 high enough that I should be doing something more than calpol and fluids? Sorry, not used to this.
